component.name: Agora
component.summary: Convene real AI websites into a council that debates until the problem is solved.

description.p: Agora is a multi-AI council orchestrator for the desktop. You state a problem once. A leader AI you choose decomposes it and invites other AIs into a real debate; they critique and revise until the leader declares it solved.
Every agent runs in a real Chrome tab driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, using the login you already have. Nothing is proxied through a server and no telemetry is collected.
Every agent's words are stored verbatim, with a hash that is re-checked on read. Agora never rewrites or summarises what an agent said.
